For our triumphant Xim, Conqueror of Vontor and Crusher of Slugs&hellip;''"<br />"''Whose Fist Shall Enclose the Stars&hellip;''"<br />"''&hellip;and&hellip; Whose Name Shall Outlive Time&hellip;''"<br />"''May he and his beloved Queen reign forever.|Robeir II, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Pre-Republic era Lord)|Tion]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Fasol Jaminere|Jaminere]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Keldrath]], in the [[Holoplay/Legends|holoplay]] ''[[Xim at Vontor]]''|<ref name="XaV" />}}
The [[Duke of Cron]] '''Robeir II''' was a noble [[Cronese]] man, possibly fictional, from the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] who lived during the [[Xim Wars]]. Robeir II was a character who appeared in the [[Holoplay/Legends|holoplay]] ''[[Xim at Vontor]]'', which was written by the [[holowright]] [[Peshosloc]] and portrayed the events of the [[Third Battle of Vontor]]. In the play, Robeir II traveled to [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Deathknell]]'' during the battle, via a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and accompanied by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Keldrath]] and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Pre-Republic era Lord)|Tion]].<ref name="XaV" />
